in_sanskrit.name: धर्मवीर
in_sanskrit.meaning: धर्म (dharma) - righteousness, virtue, morality, law; वीर (veer) - hero, brave, valiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A hero who embodies righteousness, virtue, morality, and law.

in_hindi.name: धर्मबीर
in_hindi.meaning: धर्म (dharma) - धरना (dhranā) - to uphold, maintain; बीर (bir) - brave, valiant
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who upholds, maintains righteousness, virtue, morality, and law with bravery and valiance.

in_tamil.name: தர்மபிர
in_tamil.long_meaning: A protector of dharma, righteousness, virtue, morality, and law.

in_telugu.name: ధర్మబిర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: A hero who embodies dharma, righteousness, virtue, morality, and law.

in_marathi.name: Dharmbir
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dharma (duty, righteousness) + Bir (hero)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmbir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who upholds and embodies dharma, the eternal cosmic law.

in_bengali.name: Dharmbir
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Dharma (duty, righteousness) + Bir (hero)
